Title: Make generic wiki search prompts deterministically reach the read-only search tool path.
Description: The live local Agent-mode probe accepted a generic wiki/tool-search request, the context planner preloaded the right memories and page, and then the turn stalled in Thinking with no tool call or final answer. Add a deterministic fallback for generic wiki/search prompts so the agent reaches memorysmith_unified_search or an equivalent read-only search path even when the model stalls. Acceptance criteria: clearly scoped wiki-search prompts trigger a tool call or explicit fallback within a bounded time, the trace records the chosen path, and no write-capable tools are used. Validation: run the local chat probe and a regression test covering a generic wiki search request.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Evidence: the 2026-05-24 local-profile probe on /chat reached 23.0s elapsed and still showed Waiting for first token even though the trace had already preloaded context and selected a read-only wiki search path.
